source.citation: Miron, G. D., Kulik, D. A., & Lothenbach, B. (2022). Porewater compositions of Portland cement with and without silica fume calculated using the fine-tuned CASH+NK solid solution model. Materials and Structures 55, 212.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Table 5 read on the rendered page (it is printed rotated) and compared with the text layer
transcription.note: The fine-tuned CASH+NK model: the Gibbs energies of the two calcium alkali end-members TCNh and TCKh raised by 5.0 and 7.0 kJ/mol from those of Miron2022a, which improves the Na and K of calculated cement pore solutions; the other end-members and the interaction parameters are unchanged (Table 5, footnote). Tables 3 and 4 are read in the text layer: they reprint the PC4 cement and the Parrott-Killoh constants of Lothenbach et al. (2008), transcribed independently in LothenbachLeSaout2008.json, and a test requires the two transcriptions to agree.

pc4_normative_phases.location: Table 3 (p. 4), PC4 column, g/100 g, reprinted from Lothenbach et al. (2008); the last four rows are present as solid solution in the clinker phases

blaine_PC4.description: Blaine surface area of the PC4 cement, reprinted from Lothenbach et al. (2008).

notes: Table 5 also lists fine-tuned TCLih, TCRbh and TCCsh, which the CASH+NK model does not need; they are not transcribed.
